The '''Thicket''' was the debris field surrounding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] that contained the [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] left by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:V-19_HtH3.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] in the Thicket]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] in search of [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa]] root necessary for an antidote to the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. They found themselves unable to leave the planet due to a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] left around the planet by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] when they abandoned the world. The locals stranded on Iego thought the LaserWeb was the deity known as [[Drol/Legends|Drol]]. Skywalker and Kenobi were forced to destroy the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] grid in order to return to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to deliver the Reeksa root. They succeeded in destroying most of the LaserWeb, enough to allow themselves to leave the planet, along with anyone else that wished to leave.

Later, after the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]], Skywalker and Kenobi were called back to Iego by [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]] to investigate a suspected return of Separatist forces in the section of the debris field around Iego known as the Thicket. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ordered two manned [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] into the Thicket to search for any sign of Separatist activity, one of the fighters was destroyed by an unmanned probe reprogrammed by the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]]. The second fighter was destroyed by the reactivated LaserWeb Defense Station.
